description: Machine-readable contract for the @tables block declared inside an asx.mini-app.v1 manifest. Each (username, app_id, table_id) triple is a fully isolated storage unit — no manifest or table row is ever shared between users, even when two users publish the same app_id.

isolation_law.description: The ghost shell stamps {{APP_OWNER}} and {{APP_ID}} separately at serve time. The manifest URL is baked in — the shell is incapable of fetching another user's manifest or table rows.

scope_model.description: Three exclusive scope values. @scope controls which user_id is used as the storage path segment.

owner.meaning: Data belongs to the app publisher. Blog posts, portfolio items, product catalog. Visitors read; only the owner writes.

visitor.meaning: Data belongs to the current session user. Preferences, private notes, reading history. No visitor sees another visitor's rows.

shared.meaning: One copy; all visitors read and write. Public guestbooks, aggregate counters, shared feeds.

content-rows.description: Ordered list of rich content objects. Posts, items, entries.

relation-rows.description: Rows that reference keys in another table. Comments (reference post slug), likes, votes.

settings.description: Key/value configuration for a user or the app. Use @singleton:true for one row per scope.

counter.description: Numeric aggregate rows. View counts, reaction tallies.

feed.description: Append-only event log. Activity stream, audit trail.

row_stamping.description: Server stamps these fields on every appended row. Manifests and clients must not supply them.
row_stamping._written_by: user_id of the authenticated session that issued the POST
row_stamping._written_at: Unix epoch seconds at time of append

storage_model.format: JSONL — one JSON object per line
storage_model.mutation: not supported — rows are immutable after append; deletion requires DELETE /api/projects/{app_id} or a full table purge
storage_model.singleton_resolution: When @singleton:true, the GET route returns only the last row in the file as current state. All rows are retained for audit.
storage_model.path_creation: Server creates parent directories on first append via std::filesystem::create_directories

invariants.AT1: Each (username, app_id, table_id) triple has exactly one storage path. No row is shared between users.
invariants.AT2: @scope:owner tables may only be written by the app publisher. Any other authenticated user receives 403 OWNER_ONLY.
invariants.AT3: GET /api/apps/{username}/{app_id}/tables/{table_id} for @scope:visitor returns only the requesting session's rows — it never mixes rows from different visitors.
invariants.AT4: @scope:shared GET is public (respects app visibility). All authenticated visitors may POST.
invariants.AT5: A table_id must be declared in the manifest @tables block before rows can be written. Undeclared tables return 404 TABLE_NOT_DECLARED.
invariants.AT6: Rows are append-only. The server provides no PATCH or DELETE route for individual rows.
invariants.AT7: Server always stamps _written_by and _written_at. Client-supplied values for these fields are ignored (overwritten).
invariants.AT8: Table writes carry semantic_authority:false, topology_mutation:false, commit_authorized:false.
invariants.AT9: Table data is projection evidence in the App Host lane. It is not semantic truth and requires Ch'en/XCFE/Xul to become authoritative.
invariants.AT10: @singleton:true resolves to the last row in the file. Older rows are retained; resolution is not a delete.
invariants.AT11: Deleting a project via DELETE /api/projects/{app_id} does NOT automatically purge table data. Table purge is a separate explicit operation (future: DELETE /api/apps/{username}/{app_id}/tables/{table_id}).
invariants.AT12: The ghost shell's KHANARY_TABLE(table_id) helper always calls the owner-scoped path /api/apps/{APP_OWNER}/{APP_ID}/tables/{table_id}. APP_OWNER is baked in at serve time and cannot be altered by client-side code.

error_codes.TABLE_WRITE_FAILED: server could not append to the JSONL file
error_codes.ROW_BODY_INVALID: request body is not valid JSON
error_codes.OWNER_ONLY: write to @scope:owner table attempted by non-owner session
error_codes.SESSION_REQUIRED: visitor-scope GET or any POST without a valid session cookie
error_codes.APP_NOT_FOUND: app_id not in app_index or project doc missing
